sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos lead Chargers 10-3 at halftime
sources.description: Sean Payton's return to calling the offensive plays for the Broncos has not resulted in a major change in fortune for the unit, but they did enough to take a lead into halftime for the first time this season.
